title: DAXA: Democratising Archival X-ray Astronomy
description: DAXA is a Python module designed to make the acquisition and processing of archives of X-ray astronomy data as painless as possible. It provides a consistent interface to the downloading and cleaning processes of each telescope, allowing the user to easily create multi-mission X-ray archives, allowing for the community to make better use of archival X-ray data.
